description_en: Queries the back-to-origin IP addresses and CIDR blocks used by WAF protection clusters
description_zh: 查询WAF防护集群使用的回源IP网段
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-waf-source-ip-segment --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWafSourceIpSegment

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

IpV6s.description_en: The list of back-to-origin IP addresses and CIDR blocks used by the IPv6 WAF protection cluster
IpV6s.description_zh: IPv6防护集群使用的WAF回源IP网段列表

Ips.description_en: The list of back-to-origin IP addresses and CIDR blocks used by the IPv4 WAF protection cluster
Ips.description_zh: IPv4防护集群使用的WAF回源IP网段列表
